Create one wide 16:9 landscape image, with no border or typography. He holds a small bouquet of sunflowers in both hands at chest level, with the entire bouquet visible near the lower edge. Frame him from the waist up in a medium close-up, slightly left of center: his head, torso, and bouquet should fill most of the left half of the image. The shelter roof and glass supports recede diagonally from the upper left, with a simple bench behind him. The sea remains clearly visible across the right half of the background beyond a low coastal railing; a small distant lighthouse stands near the far-right horizon. A low dawn sun and a cloudy sky appear above the sea. Keep the man, bouquet, bus stop, and sea all clearly visible.

VISUAL STYLE
Render the subject as a hand-painted watercolor illustration with contemporary Japanese animation-inspired drawing when people appear: simplified expressive faces and very fine pencil-like contours, never photorealistic skin. Layer transparent pigment over visible cold-press paper. Let pale powder-blue and warm beige washes bleed and pool softly in the background while retaining crisp, delicate detail at the focal face and hands. Leave luminous paper-white highlights and use one richer warm accent from the subject. The result should feel airy and visibly painted with water. Avoid realistic portrait rendering, opaque digital paint, thick black outlines, and smooth computer gradients.
